q: In the first place, there is life in water by which everything is made green.

s: vessel accompanies world (as man goes through the world)
q: With a vessel he contracteth friendship; with a vessel he goeth through the world.

s: acts and accountability requires bearing the result of one's own acts (for every person)
q: Every one must bear the result of his own acts, and adjust his own account.

s: acts and accountability requires adjusting one's own account (for every person)
q: Every one must bear the result of his own acts, and adjust his own account.

s: world is temporary human residence (people are not to remain in it)
q: Since ye are not to remain in this world, why practise ye pride?

s: pride is practiced people (despite the world's impermanence)
q: Since ye are not to remain in this world, why practise ye pride?

s: dispute is not to be with the fool (people should avoid it)
q: Dispute not with a fool.

s: food becomes impure impure (when it enters a sinful body)
q: When the food entereth a sinful body, it becometh impure as if spat upon.

s: God is independent of vessel (entirely)
q: Nanak, only the one True God is independent of a vessel.

s: vessel is necessary for existence (for everyone)
q: From a vessel a vessel is born; none may exist without a vessel.

s: vessel gives birth to kings
q: Why call her bad from whom are born kings? From a vessel a vessel is born; none may exist without a vessel.

s: vessel is used for conception (man is conceived in it)
q: In a vessel man is conceived, from a vessel he is born, with a vessel he is betrothed and married.

s: vessel is used for birth (man is born from it)
q: In a vessel man is conceived, from a vessel he is born, with a vessel he is betrothed and married.

s: vessel is associated with marriage (man is betrothed and married with it)
q: In a vessel man is conceived, from a vessel he is born, with a vessel he is betrothed and married.

s: vessel is associated with friendship (man contracts friendship with it)
q: With a vessel he contracteth friendship; with a vessel he goeth through the world.

s: Guru Nanak is devoted to True Guru (as a sacrifice a hundred times a day)
q: I am a sacrifice to my Guru a hundred times a day, Who without any delay made demigods out of men.

s: God bestows kindness (being pleased)
q: O Creator, Thou art the Giver; being pleased Thou bestowest and practisest kindness.

s: God practises kindness (being pleased)
q: O Creator, Thou art the Giver; being pleased Thou bestowest and practisest kindness.

s: God knows all things
q: Thou knowest all things; Thou givest and takest life with a word.

s: God gives life (with a word)
q: Thou knowest all things; Thou givest and takest life with a word.

s: God takes life (with a word)
q: Thou knowest all things; Thou givest and takest life with a word.
